<title level="1" right="Action">[Take Cover](/Actions.aspx?ID=2307) <actions string="Single Action" /></title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 418

**Requirements** You are benefiting from [standard cover](/Rules.aspx?ID=2372), are near a feature that allows you to take cover, or are [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88).

</column>

---

You press yourself against a wall or duck behind an obstacle to take better advantage of cover. If you would have standard cover, you instead gain greater cover, which provides a +4 circumstance bonus to AC; to Reflex saves against area effects; and to [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) checks to [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=2404), [Sneak](/Actions.aspx?ID=2405), or otherwise avoid detection. Otherwise, you gain standard cover (a +2 circumstance bonus instead). If you're prone, you gain greater cover against ranged attacks. Take Cover lasts until you move from your current space, use an [attack](/Traits.aspx?ID=540) action, become [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=95), or end it as a free action.
